result.reason: The added provision appropriately extends the licences to Corio’s Affiliates and contractors and is narrowly and professionally drafted. However, it does not make the fully paid-up licence in Section 2.2 irrevocable, and it does not expressly permit transfer to successors, including an M&A successor. The existing reference to Section 14.1 cannot establish compliance because that provision is not supplied. The margin comment cannot cure these omissions in the operative language.
